presets.name: Natural Color
presets.why: Closest to what the eye expects, useful for general orientation and broad communication.
presets.goodFor: Coastlines, cities, clouds, general land cover context
presets.caution: Vegetation stress and burn scars can be less obvious than in false-color views.

presets.name: Color Infrared
presets.why: Pushes healthy vegetation into vivid reds by using near-infrared reflectance.
presets.goodFor: Vegetation vigor, wetlands, crop boundaries, water-land separation
presets.caution: Urban surfaces and bare ground can look unfamiliar to non-remote-sensing audiences.

presets.name: Burn And Moisture
presets.why: Highlights moisture differences and makes burn scars, dry vegetation, and exposed soils more distinct.
presets.goodFor: Wildfire assessment, drought patterns, moisture gradients, disturbance mapping
presets.caution: This is analytically powerful but visually abstract compared with natural color.

presets.name: Urban / Geology
presets.why: Separates built-up surfaces, bare materials, and some geologic variation more strongly than natural color.
presets.goodFor: Urban extent, exposed soils, lithologic contrast, infrastructure context
presets.caution: Vegetation cues become less intuitive than in natural or color-infrared renderings.
